status.pageOpenedFromCache: Opened the page from the local cache
status.retryAfterBodySync: Try again after the page body finishes syncing
status.databaseStartFailed: Couldn’t turn the page into a database

collaboration.disconnected: Collaboration disconnected — local changes are kept on this device
collaboration.storageError: Collaboration saving is paused by a server storage problem — changes are kept in this device’s recovery copy and will be retried automatically.
collaboration.storageRecovered: Server storage recovered, and pending collaboration changes were saved automatically.
collaboration.recoveryFailed: Couldn’t save the recovery copy on this device — your changes weren’t saved to it. This won’t retry automatically, so copy your content to keep it.

restored.title: The server’s data changed
restored.body: The server was restored from a backup or replaced by another one, so it no longer matches this device. To avoid overwriting it, this device isn’t sending its changes.
restored.countFailed: Couldn’t tell whether there are unsent changes. Any there are go away when you reload from the server.
restored.unsent_one: {{count}} unsent change goes away when you reload from the server. If you need it, choose “Later” and copy it first.
restored.unsent_other: {{count}} unsent changes go away when you reload from the server. If you need them, choose “Later” and copy them first.
restored.failed: Couldn’t remove this device’s copies. Try again.

disconnected: Connection lost · Changes will be sent when you’re back online
disconnectedPending_one: Connection lost · Changes are kept on this device and will be sent when you’re back online
disconnectedPending_other: Connection lost · Changes are kept on this device and will be sent when you’re back online
serverMovedPending_one: This server’s data moved to another server · Changes are only on this device and won’t be saved
serverMovedPending_other: This server’s data moved to another server · Changes are only on this device and won’t be saved
serverPausedPending_one: This server isn’t taking changes right now · Changes are kept on this device and will be sent when it does
serverPausedPending_other: This server isn’t taking changes right now · Changes are kept on this device and will be sent when it does
restoredPaused: The server’s data changed, so this device isn’t sending its changes
refusedEdits: You can no longer edit this page, so changes made here that couldn’t be sent were removed. Copy the page as it was here to keep them.
keptChangeRefused: The server didn’t accept a change kept on this device, so it was removed from here.
dlpRefusedEdits: Your organization’s data loss prevention policy blocks a sensitive term in what you wrote, so it wasn’t saved. Copy the page as it was here to keep it.
lockRefusedKept: Changes made here that couldn’t be sent were removed. Copy what you wrote to keep it.
unsavedChanges: Your change couldn’t be kept on this device and isn’t saved yet. Keep this tab open — it’ll be sent again once the server or this device can take it.
refusedEditsCopied: Copied page as it was here
refusedEditsNotCopied: Couldn’t copy the page as it was here

pageBusy.copying: This page is being copied, so it can’t be edited for a moment. You can edit it again once the copy is done.
pageBusy.moving: Blocks of this page are being moved, so it can’t be edited for a moment. You can edit it again once that’s done.
pageBusy.wiki: This page is being converted to or from a wiki, so it can’t be edited for a moment. You can edit it again once that’s done.
pageBusy.deleting: This page is being deleted permanently
pageBusy.other: This page is busy with another change, so it can’t be edited for a moment. You can edit it again once that’s done.
pageBusy.workspaceMoved: This page’s workspace moved to another server, so it can’t be edited here.
pageBusy.workspaceSending: This page’s workspace is moving to another server, so it can’t be edited here.
pageBusy.workspaceMoving: This page is being moved to another workspace, so it can’t be opened for a moment. It opens again once it’s there.

offlinePill.label: Offline
offlinePill.tip: You’re not connected to the server. Changes sync as soon as you’re back online.
offlinePill.tipPending_one: {{count}} edit will sync the next time you’re online. It’s kept on this device.
offlinePill.tipPending_other: {{count}} edits will sync the next time you’re online. They’re kept on this device.
offlinePill.tipReadOnly: You’re not connected to the server. Reconnecting…

offlineMark.title: No connection to the server
offlineMark.body: Reconnect to the server to use everything.
